# Additions to Daniel Chapter 1 (Prayer of Azariah & Song of the Three) — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus (Theodotion recension), Additions to Daniel 1 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADD_001_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition 1: Inserted between Daniel 3:23 and 3:24. The three young men are in the furnace. The fire is real. And they sing.*

*The Prayer of Azariah is a penitential prayer — Israel has sinned, there is no temple, no sacrifice, nothing left but a broken heart. The Song of the Three (the Benedicite, "Bless the Lord, all works of the Lord") is one of the great liturgical poems of all time, used for centuries in Christian morning prayer. The refrain is its engine: "sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever."]*

---

### The Prayer of Azariah

**Pr.Az.1** They walked right through the fire, singing to God, blessing the Lord.

**Pr.Az.2** Azariah stopped and prayed. Standing there in the heart of the furnace, he opened his mouth and said:

**Pr.Az.3** "Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our fathers —
praised and lifted high above all things, forever.

**Pr.Az.4** Blessed is your holy and glorious name —
most highly praised and lifted high above all things, forever.

**Pr.Az.5** You are righteous in everything you have done to us.
All your works are true. All your ways are straight. All your judgments are truth itself.

**Pr.Az.6** Every judgment you have executed — everything you brought down on us and on Jerusalem, the holy city of our ancestors — was true and just. You brought it all on us because of our sins.

**Pr.Az.7** Because we sinned. We acted lawlessly. We walked away from you.

**Pr.Az.8** We sinned in every way there was to sin. We refused to listen to your commandments.

**Pr.Az.9** We did not keep them. We did not do what you commanded us — what would have been for our own good.

**Pr.Az.10** Everything you brought on us, everything you did to us — you did it in just judgment.

**Pr.Az.11** You handed us over to our enemies — lawless men, rebels who hate you, an unjust king who may be the worst person in the whole world.

**Pr.Az.12** Right now we cannot even open our mouths. Your servants — the people who worship you — we are covered in shame and disgrace.

**Pr.Az.13** Do not give us up forever, for the sake of your name.
Do not tear up your covenant.

**Pr.Az.14** Do not pull your mercy away from us —
for the sake of Abraham, whom you loved,
for the sake of Isaac, your servant,
for the sake of Israel, your holy one —

**Pr.Az.15** the ones you promised to make as numerous as the stars of the sky and as the grains of sand on the seashore.

**Pr.Az.16** Lord, we have become the fewest of all peoples. We are humbled this day across the whole earth — all because of our sins.

**Pr.Az.17** Right now there is no prince, no prophet, no leader. There is no burnt offering, no sacrifice, no grain offering, no incense, no place to bring our first fruits to you, no way to find mercy.

**Pr.Az.18** But accept us — though all we have to offer is a soul that is broken and a spirit brought low.

**Pr.Az.19** Let this be our sacrifice before you today — as good as thousands of rams and bulls, as good as ten thousands of fat lambs.
Let it be wholly pleasing before you.
Because those who trust in you are never put to shame.

**Pr.Az.20** Now, with our whole hearts, we follow you.
We fear you. We seek your face.

**Pr.Az.21** Do not put us to shame. Deal with us gently.
Deal with us with the fullness of your mercy.

**Pr.Az.22** Rescue us with your wonderful works.
Bring glory to your name, Lord.

**Pr.Az.23** Let everyone who does evil to your servants be brought to shame — stripped of power, their strength broken and crushed.

**Pr.Az.24** Let them know: you alone are the Lord God, glorious over all the earth."

**Pr.Az.25** Meanwhile, outside, the king's servants kept on stoking the furnace — naphtha, pitch, tow, brushwood, everything they had.

**Pr.Az.26** The flames shot out above the furnace forty-nine cubits.

**Pr.Az.27** They spread and burned the Chaldean servants who were standing around it.

**Pr.Az.28** But the angel of the Lord descended into the furnace and joined Azariah and his companions. He drove the fiery flame away from them.

**Pr.Az.29** He made the inside of the furnace feel like a cool, moist breeze was blowing through it. The fire did not touch them. It did not hurt them. It did not trouble them in any way.

---

### The Song of the Three Young Men (The Benedicite)

**Song.1** Then the three of them — as if with one voice — burst out praising and glorifying and blessing God there in the furnace:

**Song.2** "Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our fathers —
most highly praised and exalted above all things, forever.

**Song.3** Blessed is your holy and glorious name —
most highly praised and exalted above all things, forever.

**Song.4** Blessed are you in the temple of your holy glory —
most highly praised and exalted above all things, forever.

**Song.5** Blessed are you upon the throne of your kingdom —
most highly praised and exalted above all things, forever.

**Song.6** Blessed are you who look down into the depths
and sit enthroned above the cherubim —
praised and exalted above all things, forever.

**Song.7** Blessed are you in the vault of heaven —
most highly praised and glorified, forever.

---

**Song.8** Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.9** Bless the Lord, you angels of the Lord —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.10** Bless the Lord, you heavens —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.11** Bless the Lord, all you waters above the heavens —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.12** Bless the Lord, all you hosts of the Lord —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.13** Bless the Lord, sun and moon —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.14** Bless the Lord, stars of heaven —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.15** Bless the Lord, every shower of rain and drop of dew —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.16** Bless the Lord, all you winds —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.17** Bless the Lord, fire and scorching heat —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.18** Bless the Lord, bitter winter cold and blazing summer —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.19** Bless the Lord, dews and hoarfrosts —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.20** Bless the Lord, frost and piercing cold —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.21** Bless the Lord, ice and snow —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.22** Bless the Lord, nights and days —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.23** Bless the Lord, light and darkness —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.24** Bless the Lord, lightning and storm clouds —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.25** Let the earth bless the Lord —
let it sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.26** Bless the Lord, mountains and hills —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.27** Bless the Lord, everything that grows from the earth —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.28** Bless the Lord, seas and rivers —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.29** Bless the Lord, all you springs —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.30** Bless the Lord, you sea monsters and everything that moves through the waters —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.31** Bless the Lord, all you birds of the sky —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.32** Bless the Lord, all wild creatures and cattle —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.33** Bless the Lord, all you people —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.34** Bless the Lord, O Israel —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.35** Bless the Lord, you priests —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.36** Bless the Lord, you servants of the Lord —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.37** Bless the Lord, spirits and souls of the righteous —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.38** Bless the Lord, you who are holy, you whose hearts are humble —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

**Song.39** Bless the Lord, Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael —
sing his praise, lift him high above all things, forever.

For he has pulled us back from the edge of death.
He has saved us from the power of the grave.
He has rescued us from the heart of the burning furnace —
reached into the very fire and brought us out.

**Song.40** Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good —
his steadfast love endures forever.

**Song.41** Bless all who fear the Lord, the God of gods —
sing his praise, give him thanks,
for his steadfast love endures forever."
